content.comment_body: Has anyone managed to get network simulation working in [product_name] V7? I have two programs open, each configured as master and slave with respective IP addresses on the same subnet and gateway. I tried different gateway configurations. The master uses a network input block linked to the slave's IP, with the slave's block connected through logical operations. When I run simulations and connect the network, activating the input on the slave doesn't affect the master. I think I might be missing something. Any suggestions?
Hello, maybe you can translate German to English. There’s a thread in the German forum discussing [product_name] V7.0 network simulation. It might be helpful. Good luck.
Are you referring to a master-slave connection, or do you mean server-client communication?

Thanks for the replies. I have been using Google Translate for the German forum and saw the link you mentioned, which is about passing analogue data between server and slave. I haven't managed to do it correctly yet. You’re right—I meant server/client. I’m starting with basic digital output control of the slave and will share progress if I succeed.

I finally figured it out. Using Google Translate, I regularly checked the German forum and experimented with the examples provided. Understanding the VM parameters took some time. If anyone wants, I can share my test programs. I managed to set up communication in both directions for both analogue and digital data—server and client. Thanks to everyone who contributed across the forums. Now moving on to HMI communication.

Hi, when I try to configure a network input, it doesn't work. I've connected both master and slave with similar IP addresses and can communicate with both, but I can't add a network input to my program. What am I missing? Thanks, [user_name]
I’d like to see your sample program if you managed to upload it. Thanks, [user_name]

Here is a file from the German forum showing a simple switch for input and output over the network. Check the tool for ethernet connections—connection 1 demonstrates the data transfer. Hope this helps; I spent most of the night working on it.
These are the programs I created. Hope this helps.
